purpose: Adjacent harvest (Part G): naturally occurring observable states AFTER successful PLL/radio initialization on the BCM4352 AC path. No checkpoint is classified STRONG/PROVEN here; the operational-checkpoint blocker (d4.checkpoint.none) is NOT solved.

candidates.location: wlc_phy_switch_radio_acphy A/B lock-poll exit (A: 0xaaabe read_radio_reg(0x80b)&1; B: 0xaabc4/0xaabd5 read_radio_reg(0x0b/0x20b)&1)
candidates.completed: radio PLL/synth enable bit observed set within the bounded 101x100us poll
candidates.observable: the selected radio PLL-lock register bit (0x80b bit0 / 0x0b bit0 / 0x20b bit0)
candidates.pending_async_work: no - poll is synchronous and bounded
candidates.mac_psm_state: MAC suspended (wlapi_suspend_mac_and_wait @0xaa7bb); PSM running from D2A
candidates.why_may_be_useful: the first hardware-observable evidence that the radio PLL/SYNTH is up; a natural post-PLL checkpoint before sub_9fb72

candidates.observable: radio regs written per rev table; no single documented readback
candidates.why_may_be_useful: covers the 2069 rev-dependent init regardless of A/B class; a class-independent convergence checkpoint

candidates.observable: radio PLL regs 0x8c7/0x8c8 = 0xFFFF and 0x8c9/0x8cc masked fields; no documented lock bit read
candidates.why_may_be_useful: the concrete 2069 RF-PLL programming point; pairs with the pi+0x8bf proven values

candidates.completed: MAC re-enabled after radio ON; more PHY regs follow (0xab455..)
candidates.why_may_be_useful: marks the transition back to an active MAC, but is not the end of PHY init

candidates.observable: none (pi+0x16e is a byte, not a gate)

notes: This does NOT resolve d4.checkpoint.none; no candidate is STRONG/PROVEN.
CP-P1..CP-P3 are all synchronous (no async DMA/IRQ dependency) and are good future checkpoint material once the D3B->wlc_phy_init successor path is host-tested.
